name: 匹兹堡睡眠质量指数
instructions: 以下问题涉及您过去一个月的睡眠情况。请根据实际情况作答。
instructionsEn: The following questions concern your sleep over the past month. Please answer according to your actual situation.
license: Buysse 等编制，可免费用于非商业用途，使用时请注明出处。

items.text: 过去一个月，您通常晚上几点上床睡觉？
items.textEn: Over the past month, what time do you usually get into bed at night?

items.text: 过去一个月，您通常需要多长时间才能入睡？
items.textEn: Over the past month, how long does it usually take you to fall asleep?

items.text: 过去一个月，您通常早上几点起床？
items.textEn: Over the past month, what time do you usually get up in the morning?

items.text: 过去一个月，您实际每晚睡多少小时？
items.textEn: Over the past month, how many hours of actual sleep do you get each night?

items.text: 过去一个月，您入睡困难的频率如何？
items.textEn: Over the past month, how often have you had trouble falling asleep?

items.text: 过去一个月，您夜间醒来或早醒的频率如何？
items.textEn: Over the past month, how often have you woken up during the night or woken up too early?

items.text: 过去一个月，您夜间起床上厕所的频率如何？
items.textEn: Over the past month, how often have you had to get up to use the bathroom during the night?

items.text: 过去一个月，您呼吸不畅的频率如何？
items.textEn: Over the past month, how often have you had trouble breathing?

items.text: 过去一个月，您咳嗽或打鼾的频率如何？
items.textEn: Over the past month, how often have you coughed or snored?

items.text: 过去一个月，您感到寒冷的频率如何？
items.textEn: Over the past month, how often have you felt too cold?

items.text: 过去一个月，您感到炎热的频率如何？
items.textEn: Over the past month, how often have you felt too hot?

items.text: 过去一个月，您做噩梦的频率如何？
items.textEn: Over the past month, how often have you had bad dreams?

items.text: 过去一个月，您感到疼痛的频率如何？
items.textEn: Over the past month, how often have you felt pain?

items.text: 过去一个月，您因其他原因睡不好的频率如何？
items.textEn: Over the past month, how often have you had trouble sleeping for other reasons?

items.text: 过去一个月，您服用安眠药的频率如何？
items.textEn: Over the past month, how often have you taken sleeping pills?

items.text: 过去一个月，您白天感到困倦的频率如何？
items.textEn: Over the past month, how often have you felt drowsy during the day?

items.text: 过去一个月，您白天感到精力不足的频率如何？
items.textEn: Over the past month, how often have you lacked energy during the day?

items.text: 过去一个月，您对目前睡眠质量的总体评价如何？
items.textEn: Over the past month, how would you rate your sleep quality overall?

items.text: 过去一个月，您是否有床伴或室友？
items.textEn: Over the past month, have you had a bed partner or roommate?

totalBands.description: 总分低于6，睡眠质量良好。
总分6-11，睡眠质量一般，存在轻度睡眠问题。
总分11-16，睡眠质量较差，建议关注睡眠健康。
总分16及以上，睡眠质量很差，建议寻求专业帮助。
